1.consolidated_definition: Hormiga de gran tamaño, de color café o rojizo, con cabeza lisa y brillante, mandíbulas desarrolladas y tórax bien separado del abdomen. (Formicidae; Atta spp.).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Large ant of coffee or reddish color, with smooth and shiny head, developed mandibles and well-separated thorax from abdomen. (Formicidae; Atta spp.)
